title: Drought
text: The streams run thin. Prey grows thirsty and gathers at the few remaining water sources — exposed, but defended by every desperate creature in the kingdom.

choices.label: Defend your watering holes (defense +25% for 6 turns)
Hunt the desperate (attack +20% for 6 turns, but -25% production)
Migrate to the river (one of your territories goes feral — flips neutral)

title: Great Migration
text: Herds move through the kingdom. Tens of thousands of prey, in clouds of dust and antler. The hunting will be good — for whoever gets there first.

choices.label: Feast (+90 prey)
Pursue the herd (production +20% for 5 turns)
Let them pass undisturbed (+10 hunters at your strongest territory)

title: Forest Fire
text: A dry-lightning strike. Black smoke rises across the ridge. The fire moves fast through the pine.

choices.label: Outrun it (lose 30% of one territory's pack)
Hunt the panicked (+50 prey, but production -20% for 5 turns from smoke)

title: Cub Season
text: Snow melts. Dens fill with young — wolf pups, bear cubs, lion kits, eagle eyas. Every territory you hold is teeming with life that needs feeding.

choices.label: Welcome the new generation (+5 hunters in every owned territory in a few seasons)

title: The Alpha is Wounded
text: Your strongest territory's leader takes a deep gash from a rival — or from a hoof. The pack is uneasy.

choices.label: Step into the leadership void (a younger hunter rises: +30 hunters at strongest)
Let the alpha recover (defense +20% for 5 turns)

title: Great Carrion
text: A massive elk lies dead in the meadow — probably from disease, maybe from a fall. A week of food for any predator strong enough to claim it. But the smell will draw rivals.

choices.label: Claim it (+120 prey)
Drag it home (+50 hunters at strongest, but -30 prey to spoils)
Let the scavengers have it (no effect)

title: Sickness in the Pack
text: Hunters return coughing, eyes weeping. The young die first. A wave of disease moves through your territories.

choices.label: Quarantine the sick (army -25% in one territory)
Push through it (production -25% for 8 turns)

title: A Strange Predator
text: Something new in the kingdom. Tracks you don't recognize. A scream in the night. The other species are nervous.

choices.label: Hunt it (-30 prey, but defense +15% for 8 turns from heightened wariness)
Avoid its territory (one of your territories goes neutral if you don't reinforce)

title: A Human Scout
text: Two-legged. Smells of fire and metal. He has been watching from the ridge for days. He is mapping the kingdom.

choices.label: Kill him quietly (defense +10% for 10 turns; village won't notice for a while)
Let him pass (accelerate Hunters' arrival — they come at 4 territories instead of 5)

title: A Lone Giant
text: A massive bear — bigger than any you've seen — emerges from the deep woods. It is old. It has scars from things you don't have words for.

choices.label: Fight it (lose 35 hunters in one territory; gain +40 prey from the corpse)
Let it pass (the giant claims a neutral territory — random territory gets +50 to defenders)

title: Star-Woken Omen
text: A bright streak across the night sky. The young stop howling. The old hunters say their kills smell strange for three nights after.

choices.label: Mark the territory as sacred (-30 prey, fortify a random territory)
Hunt on (attack +20% for 4 turns from heightened instinct)

title: The Long Winter
text: Snow falls and does not stop. The streams freeze solid. Prey grows lean. Every hunter feels it.

choices.label: Endure (all hunters -15% effective for 6 turns, but +10% recovery after)
